decisions.reason: As a GIS solution platform close to the firm's core integration business, it likely creates reusable value across client projects, so its option value remains high relative to the cost of keeping it available.

Mobile field data capture fits the firm's geospatial enterprise focus, but as a more standalone application it likely requires higher ongoing product effort and faces more market uncertainty than a component or platform.

The search extension was still being versioned in 2019 and is a low-cost complement to the firm's established web map offering, so keeping this option open is attractive unless demand clearly weakens.
